questions.question: If you realize you may be late to your destination, you should:
questions.explanation: Accept that you may be late. Take a deep breath and manage your stress. Safe driving is more important than arriving on time.

questions.question: The trailer hand valve:

options.text: Should always be used for parking.
Should only be used for parking on a downgrade.
Should never be used for parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should never be used for parking.
questions.explanation: Do not use the trailer hand valve for parking. It may release air pressure and disable the brakes. Use the parking brake or wheel chocks instead.

questions.question: When driving under bridges or overpasses, you should:

options.text: Trust the posted clearance height is correct.
Not trust the posted clearance height.
Measure the height before you drive through.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not trust the posted clearance height.
questions.explanation: Do not assume posted heights are accurate. The road may have been repaved or snow may have accumulated since the sign was posted. Slow down and find another route if you are unsure your vehicle will fit.

questions.question: Load hazardous materials:
questions.explanation: Always load hazardous materials away from heat sources. Heat can cause explosions or fires with flammable materials.

questions.question: What is the average driver's reaction time?
questions.explanation: Most drivers react in about three-quarters of a second to one second. At 55 mph, you travel about 61 feet during this time.

questions.question: How much water is needed for a vehicle to hydroplane?
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when tires lose grip and slide on water. It does not take much water for this to happen.

questions.question: In hot weather, spots where tar bleeds on the pavement:

options.text: Have the same traction as the rest of the road.
Have more traction than the rest of the road.

questions.explanation: In hot weather, tar rises to the road surface. These spots are very slippery, so be careful when driving over them.

questions.question: Heights posted on bridges:
questions.explanation: Do not assume posted bridge heights are correct. The road may have been repaved or snow may have accumulated since the sign was posted.

questions.question: Hydroplaning:

options.text: Usually happens at speeds over 65 mph.
Can happen with just a little water on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can happen with just a little water on the road.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning occurs when tires lose grip and slide on water. It does not take much water for this to happen.

questions.question: What removes alcohol from the bloodstream?
questions.explanation: The body removes alcohol at a set rate. Coffee and exercise cannot speed this up. You must wait for your body to process the alcohol naturally.

questions.question: What does rough acceleration do?

options.text: It is required on slippery surfaces.

questions.explanation: Always speed up slowly and smoothly. Rough acceleration can damage the vehicle.

questions.question: When backing up to couple a trailer, the trailer brakes should be:
questions.explanation: Before backing under the trailer to couple it, lock the trailer brakes. This is important for safe operation of combination vehicles.

questions.question: Why is turning toward the driver's side recommended when backing with a trailer?

options.text: Power lines should be on the passenger's side.
Other drivers can help on the passenger's side.

questions.explanation: Back toward the left side of your vehicle. This gives you the best view of the rear of your vehicle.

questions.question: Who must label hazardous materials?
questions.explanation: The shipper must package, mark, and label hazardous materials. They must also supply the warning placards.

questions.question: How can a driver stay alert while driving?
questions.explanation: Heavy foods and a warm cab can make you drowsy. Exercise and a healthy diet help you stay alert while driving.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver confronts you, you should:

options.text: Keep your vehicle in front of them.

questions.explanation: Don't react to an aggressive driver's actions or angry gestures. Do not make eye contact. Get out of their way safely if you can.

questions.question: If you must drive slowly and block traffic, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your four-way flashers to warn drivers behind you that you are moving slowly.

questions.question: When accelerating on a wet or slippery road, a driver should:
questions.explanation: Speed up very slowly when the road has poor traction.

questions.question: Before driving a vehicle with power steering, you should check that:

options.text: The hoses are connected to the battery.

questions.explanation: Check the hoses, pump, and fluid level in the power steering system. Look for leaks in the hoses.

questions.question: If you find a leaking tank, you should:

options.text: Drive with flashers on to warn other drivers.
Finish the trip, then report it.

questions.explanation: Transporting liquids or gases in a leaking tank is unsafe and illegal.
